title: WPSB/29/2000 of JASPAL SINGH Vs U.P.S.R.T.C. and OTHERS

paras.text:
C.J.'s Court
Civil Misc. Writ Petition No.29 of 2000
Jaspal Singh Grawal ............. Petitioner
 Versus
U.P.S.R.T.C. through
its General Manager (Karmik)
U.P.Government, Lucknow and
Others. ............. Respondents.
Hon'ble A.A.Desai,A.C.J.
Hon'ble M.C.Jain,J.
The petitioner is working as driver in the respon-dent corporation. Initially from Rudrapur he was trans-ferred to Bijnor. On his request, this transfer was
cancelled and he was brought back to Rudrapur. Subse-quently, by order dated 17.11.2000 he was transferred
from Rudrapur to Haldwani. The petitioner has challenged
this transfer mainly on the ground that he was the
president of the union and in recent election he lost.
Under the pressure of the elected president, the instant
transfer has been effected. As such, the transfer is
not in good faith. Undisputedly, the petitioner was at
Rudrapur for more than five years. Therefore, he was due
for transfer. In view of this, we do not entertain
the grounds as canvassed. Moreover, the distance
between Haldwani and Rudrapur as reported is only 34 kms.
As such, it will cause no hardship to the petitioner.
We are, therefore, not inclined to entertain the writ
petition.
The petitioner is, however, at liberty to make
representation to the authorities concerned for post-poning the effect of transfer impugned before us. If
such representation is made, the authorities shall con-sider and decide the same expeditiously. With this
observation, this writ petition is disposed of.
Dated:
November 22,2000.
A.Joshi (A.A.Desai,A.C.J.) (M.C.Jain,J.)
